Description: Anchor links should scroll smoothly to target section
Do: Use scroll-behavior: smooth on html element

Description: Fixed nav should not obscure content
Do: Add padding-top to body equal to nav height
Don't: Let nav overlap first section content

Description: Current page/section should be visually indicated
Do: Highlight active nav item with color/underline
Don't: No visual feedback on current location

Description: Users expect back to work predictably
Do: Preserve navigation history properly

Description: URLs should reflect current state for sharing
Do: Update URL on state/view changes

Description: Show user location in site hierarchy
Do: Use for sites with 3+ levels of depth

Description: Too many animations cause distraction and motion sickness
Do: Animate 1-2 key elements per view maximum

Description: Animations should feel responsive not sluggish
Do: Use 150-300ms for micro-interactions
Don't: Use animations longer than 500ms for UI

Description: Respect user's motion preferences
Do: Check prefers-reduced-motion media query

Description: Show feedback during async operations
Do: Use skeleton screens or spinners
Don't: Leave UI frozen with no feedback

Description: Hover effects don't work on touch devices
Do: Use click/tap for primary interactions
Don't: Rely only on hover for important actions

Description: Infinite animations are distracting
Do: Use for loading indicators only

Description: Some CSS properties trigger expensive repaints
Do: Use transform and opacity for animations

Description: Linear motion feels robotic
Do: Use ease-out for entering ease-in for exiting

Description: Stacking context conflicts cause hidden elements
Do: Define z-index scale system (10 20 30 50)

Description: Hidden overflow can clip important content
Do: Test all content fits within containers

Description: Fixed elements can overlap or be inaccessible
Do: Account for safe areas and other fixed elements
Code Example Good: Fixed nav + fixed bottom with gap

Description: New stacking contexts reset z-index
Do: Understand what creates new stacking context
Don't: Expect z-index to work across contexts

Description: Layout shift when content loads is jarring
Do: Reserve space for async content

Description: 100vh can be problematic on mobile browsers
Do: Use dvh or account for mobile browser chrome

Description: Content too wide is hard to read
Do: Limit max-width for text content (65-75ch)
Don't: Let text span full viewport width

Description: Small buttons are hard to tap accurately
Do: Minimum 44x44px touch targets

Description: Adjacent touch targets need adequate spacing
Do: Minimum 8px gap between touch targets

Description: Custom gestures can conflict with system
Do: Avoid horizontal swipe on main content

Description: 300ms tap delay feels laggy
Do: Use touch-action CSS or fastclick

Description: Accidental refresh is frustrating
Do: Disable where not needed

Description: Tactile feedback improves interaction feel
Do: Use for confirmations and important actions

Description: Keyboard users need visible focus indicators
Do: Use visible focus rings on interactive elements

Description: Visual feedback on interactive elements
Do: Change cursor and add subtle visual change
Don't: No hover feedback on clickable elements

Description: Show immediate feedback on press/click
Do: Add pressed/active state visual change

Description: Clearly indicate non-interactive elements
Do: Reduce opacity and change cursor

Description: Prevent double submission during async actions
Do: Disable button and show loading state

Description: Users need to know when something fails
Do: Show clear error messages near problem

Description: Confirm successful actions to users
Do: Show success message or visual change

Description: Prevent accidental destructive actions
Do: Confirm before delete/irreversible actions

Description: Text must be readable against background
Do: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text

Description: Don't convey information by color alone
Do: Use icons/text in addition to color

Description: Images need text alternatives
Do: Descriptive alt text for meaningful images

Description: Screen readers use headings for navigation
Do: Use sequential heading levels h1-h6
Don't: Skip heading levels or misuse for styling

Description: Interactive elements need accessible names
Do: Add aria-label for icon-only buttons

Description: All functionality accessible via keyboard
Do: Tab order matches visual order
Don't: Keyboard traps or illogical tab order

Description: Content should make sense when read aloud
Do: Use semantic HTML and ARIA properly

Description: Inputs must have associated labels
Do: Use label with for attribute or wrap input

Description: Error messages must be announced
Do: Use aria-live or role=alert for errors

Description: Allow keyboard users to skip navigation
Do: Provide skip to main content link
Don't: No skip link on nav-heavy pages

Description: Large images slow page load
Do: Use appropriate size and format (WebP)

Description: Load content as needed
Do: Lazy load below-fold images and content

Description: Large bundles slow initial load
Do: Split code by route/feature

Description: Repeat visits should be fast
Do: Set appropriate cache headers

Description: Web fonts can block rendering
Do: Use font-display swap or optional

Description: External scripts can block rendering
Do: Load non-critical scripts async/defer

Description: Large JavaScript slows interaction
Do: Monitor and minimize bundle size

Description: CSS/JS can block first paint
Do: Inline critical CSS defer non-critical

Description: Every input needs a visible label
Do: Always show label above or beside input

Description: Errors should appear near the problem
Do: Show error below related input
Don't: Single error message at top of form

Description: Validate as user types or on blur
Do: Validate on blur for most fields

Description: Use appropriate input types
Do: Use email tel number url etc

Description: Help browsers autofill correctly
Do: Use autocomplete attribute properly

Description: Mark required fields clearly
Do: Use asterisk or (required) text

Description: Let users see password while typing
Do: Toggle to show/hide password

Description: Confirm form submission status
Do: Show loading then success/error state

Description: Inputs should look interactive
Do: Use distinct input styling
Don't: Inputs that look like plain text

Description: Show appropriate keyboard for input type
Do: Use inputmode attribute

Description: Design for mobile then enhance for larger
Do: Start with mobile styles then add breakpoints

Description: Test at all common screen sizes
Mobile layouts need touch-sized targets
Do: Increase touch targets on mobile

Description: Text must be readable on all devices
Do: Minimum 16px body text on mobile

Description: Set viewport for mobile devices
Do: Use width=device-width initial-scale=1

Description: Avoid horizontal scrolling
Do: Ensure content fits viewport width

Description: Images should scale with container
Do: Use max-width: 100% on images

Description: Tables can overflow on mobile
Do: Use horizontal scroll or card layout

Description: Adequate line height improves readability
Do: Use 1.5-1.75 for body text

Description: Long lines are hard to read
Do: Limit to 65-75 characters per line

Description: Consistent type hierarchy aids scanning
Do: Use consistent modular scale

Description: Fonts should load without layout shift
Do: Reserve space with fallback font

Description: Body text needs good contrast
Do: Use darker text on light backgrounds

Description: Headings should stand out from body
Do: Clear size/weight difference

Description: Show system status during waits
Do: Show spinner/skeleton for operations > 300ms

Description: Guide users when no content exists
Do: Show helpful message and action

Description: Help users recover from errors
Do: Provide clear next steps

Description: Show progress for multi-step processes
Do: Step indicators or progress bar

Description: Transient messages for non-critical info
Do: Auto-dismiss after 3-5 seconds

Description: Confirm successful actions
Do: Brief success message

Description: Handle long content gracefully
Do: Truncate with ellipsis and expand option

Description: Use locale-appropriate date formats
Do: Use relative or locale-aware dates

Description: Format large numbers for readability
Do: Use thousand separators or abbreviations

Description: Show realistic placeholders during dev
Do: Use realistic sample data

Description: Users should be able to skip tutorials
Do: Provide Skip and Back buttons

Description: Help users find results faster
Do: Show predictions as user types

Description: Dead ends frustrate users
Do: Show 'No results' with suggestions

Description: Editing one by one is tedious
Do: Allow multi-select and bulk edit

Description: Users need to know they talk to AI
Do: Clearly label AI generated content

Description: Waiting for full text is slow
Do: Stream text response token by token

Description: Elements should respond to eye tracking before pinch
Do: Scale/highlight element on look

Description: UI needs Z-depth to separate content from environment
Do: Use glass material and z-offset

Description: Video consumes massive data and energy
Do: Click-to-play or pause when off-screen

Description: Heavy 3D/Image assets increase carbon footprint
Do: Compress and lazy load 3D models

Description: AI needs user feedback to improve
Do: Thumps up/down or 'Regenerate'

Description: Parallax/Scroll-jacking causes nausea
Do: Respect prefers-reduced-motion

Description: Search filter sort and view controls should share one contextual toolbar
Do: Keep controls compact and show active counts
Don't: Place every filter in a separate settings card

Description: Collection search must disclose which fields and records it matches
Do: Describe searchable fields and distinguish global search
Don't: Use a generic Search placeholder with hidden scope

Description: Toolbar search should expand only while active unless search is the primary task
Do: Autofocus on reveal and keep the active query visible
Don't: Permanently consume toolbar space with an inactive field
Code Example Good: Search button expands to focused input

Description: Filter builders need a stable Property Operator Value grammar
Do: Show compatible operators and typed value controls
Don't: Show every field at once in a generic form

Description: Users must see that filters remain active after closing the editor
Do: Show a count chip or short rule summary
Don't: Signal active filters only with icon color

Description: Complete filter rules should update results without a separate desktop Apply step
Do: Apply complete rules immediately and keep incomplete drafts local
Don't: Require Apply filters after every small change
Code Example Bad: Apply filters button below a form

Description: Users should change one predicate without rebuilding other filters
Do: Support edit duplicate remove and clear-all actions
Don't: Reset the entire filter form to change one rule

Description: Multiple sort rules must communicate primary and secondary precedence
Do: Display rules in applied order and allow reordering
Don't: Show selected fields without their precedence
Code Example Bad: Due date and Priority badges only

Description: Sort direction should match the property type and remain understandable without icons
Do: Use labels such as Newest first or Highest first
Don't: Use unexplained up and down arrows alone

Description: Search filter sort and view state should be reproducible through the URL
Do: Serialize committed state and preserve unrelated parameters
Don't: Keep all query state only in component memory

Description: Changing search filters or sorting invalidates the current page or cursor
Do: Reset pagination while preserving the new query
Don't: Keep an out-of-range page after narrowing results
Code Example Good: Change filter then return to page 1
Code Example Bad: Filter leaves user on empty page 12

Description: Large datasets require server search filter and sort before pagination
Do: Query the authoritative dataset then paginate
Don't: Filter only the currently loaded page
Code Example Good: Server predicate then stable order then limit
Code Example Bad: Hide nonmatching rows on current page only

Description: Search filter and sort editors must support keyboard navigation and focus restoration
Do: Use accessible primitives and restore focus to the trigger
Don't: Trap focus or lose focus when a popover closes

Description: Structured desktop popovers need an equivalent narrow-screen editor
Do: Use the same query model inside a Sheet or Drawer
Don't: Replace filters with unrelated mobile-only fields

Description: No-result states should preserve context and provide a direct recovery path
Do: Show the active query and offer clear or edit actions
Don't: Display a blank table or generic zero message

Description: Incomplete filter and sort drafts must not affect result queries
Do: Separate local draft state from complete URL-backed rules
Code Example Good: Choose property then operator before commit

Description: Text search and structured choices need different update timing
Do: Debounce remote text around 250 to 350 ms and apply discrete choices immediately
Don't: Debounce every control or request on every keystroke
Code Example Good: Debounced q plus immediate status selection
Code Example Bad: One global delay for all controls

Description: Desktop buttons should normally size to their label icon and padding
Do: Use intrinsic width inside a deliberate action row
Don't: Stretch routine actions across a wide card
Code Example Bad: Full-width button in a desktop settings card

Description: Full-width buttons need a workflow or responsive justification
Do: Reserve full width for narrow auth checkout mobile or single-action flows
Don't: Use full width whenever the parent has available space
Code Example Good: Full-width Sign in inside a narrow auth card
Code Example Bad: Full-width Save in a wide desktop form

Description: Form and card actions need explicit alignment wrapping and spacing
Do: Place actions in a flex action row with consistent gaps
Don't: Leave buttons as unrelated children of a vertical content stack
Code Example Good: Cancel and Save grouped at inline end
Code Example Bad: Submit button stretched below every field

Description: Flex columns and grid containers can stretch intrinsically sized buttons accidentally
Do: Inspect parent alignment and use an action row or intentional self alignment
Don't: Change the shared Button component to fight one parent layout
Code Example Bad: Button as direct child of stretching flex-col

Description: Button width should adapt independently across desktop and mobile
Do: Use content width on desktop and full width on narrow screens only when useful
Don't: Force one width behavior at every breakpoint
Code Example Good: w-full sm:w-auto for a mobile-first action

Description: Long action labels create oversized controls and slow scanning
Do: Use concise verb-led labels while preserving domain meaning
Don't: Write sentence-length labels inside primary buttons
Code Example Bad: Queue a durable full-account synchronization operation

Description: Repeated familiar actions should be recognizable before users read labels
Do: Lead with consistent icons and remove duplicated words where context is clear
Don't: Render the same short action word in every row
Code Example Good: Icon-led preview download and overflow actions
Code Example Bad: Text-only Open button in every table row

Description: Universal low-ambiguity actions can use compact icon-only controls
Do: Use icon-only for close search filter sort refresh copy and overflow
Don't: Use icon-only for unfamiliar workflow commands

Description: Primary destructive expensive and domain-specific actions need visible labels
Do: Pair a semantic icon with a concise explicit label
Don't: Hide commitments and destructive actions behind glyphs
Code Example Bad: Trash icon alone for permanent deletion

Description: Icon-only controls need both programmatic and visible-on-demand meaning
Do: Provide an accessible name Tooltip focus state and adequate hit target
Don't: Rely on the SVG filename or hover alone

Description: Navigation is faster to scan when stable destinations have consistent visual landmarks
Do: Pair one icon family with concise destination labels
Don't: Use text-only navigation with no hierarchy or mix icon families
Code Example Bad: Different icon style on every route

Description: Status icons should reinforce rather than replace exact state meaning
Do: Pair icon shape with a visible status label or token
Don't: Communicate state only through icon shape or color

Description: Icons that add no recognition or meaning make text-heavy pages busier
Do: Add icons to actions landmarks object types and statuses only
Don't: Decorate every heading field label and paragraph with a glyph

Description: Familiar secondary labels may collapse when space is constrained
Do: Hide labels responsively only after the action passes the icon-only test
Don't: Remove labels from primary or ambiguous actions on mobile

Description: Entity identity status metadata actions and local navigation should form one compact header
Do: Keep object context and controls adjacent
Don't: Scatter identity and controls across multiple cards
Code Example Good: Account identity with status and Actions trigger
Code Example Bad: Separate hero action and status cards

Description: Repeating the same entity name in breadcrumb title card and summary weakens hierarchy
Do: Choose one dominant identity expression and show each fact once
Don't: Repeat the account name at every layout level
Code Example Good: One account identity in the page header
Code Example Bad: Account name in breadcrumb H1 and hero card

Description: Actions should appear next to the object or region they change
Do: Attach entity section row field and form actions to their visible targets
Don't: Collect unrelated operations in distant cards
Code Example Good: Account Actions menu beside account status
Code Example Bad: Pause account inside a lower diagnostics card

Description: Multiple operational commands compete with identity and navigation
Do: Keep at most one primary action and place secondary commands in Actions overflow
Don't: Render sync reconcile pause files and chats as equal header buttons
Code Example Bad: Five equal outline buttons beside title

Description: Related entity destinations need one stable local navigation layer
Do: Place route-backed tabs directly below identity and metadata
Don't: Duplicate tab destinations as header buttons and cards
Code Example Bad: Chats and Files buttons plus separate navigation

Description: Breadcrumb identity metadata actions and tabs are page structure rather than content cards
Do: Use a flat header and reserve Cards for bounded content groups
Don't: Wrap every hierarchy level in rounded bordered cards
Code Example Good: Flat entity header then summary cards
Code Example Bad: Hero card around identity and actions

Description: Stable IDs and creation dates should support identity without competing with it
Do: Use muted compact key-value metadata and monospace only for identifiers
Don't: Render raw IDs repeatedly or as primary headings
Code Example Bad: Full raw ID in title card and diagnostics

Description: Entity context must remain coherent when the header wraps on narrow screens
Do: Keep identity first status visible actions grouped and tabs attached
Don't: Move actions into unrelated cards when space is limited
Code Example Good: Identity then status and Actions then tabs
Code Example Bad: Actions visible while entity identity is hidden
